类 ItemTagType.PrimitiveTagType<T>

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.inventory.meta.tags.ItemTagType.PrimitiveTagType<T>
类型参数:
T - 原始对象的泛型类型

原文：the generic type of the primitive objects

所有已实现的接口:
ItemTagType<T,T>
封闭接口:
ItemTagType<T,Z>
public static class ItemTagType.PrimitiveTagType<T> extends java.lang.Object implements ItemTagType<T,T>
默认实现，仅用于将检索或插入的值传递到下一层.

此实现不添加任何逻辑，用于为原始类型提供默认实现.

原文： A default implementation that simply exists to pass on the retrieved or inserted value to the next layer. This implementation does not add any kind of logic, but is used to provide default implementations for the primitive types.
